_comment: Copy to bench/arena/systems.json and add one entry per tool. Write each entry from what its server offers: `node bench/arena/arena.mjs tools --system NAME --repo DIR` lists its tools and their input schemas. Placeholders: {name} {qname} {owner} {path} {abspath} {line} {repo} {gi}. The graph-indexer entry checks the harness end to end: its scores must match graph-indexer's own row.

references.stopAt: ^(Possibly missed|Unbound:|Also named as a string|Other references named|Indirect subtypes|No references of kind|Dependency injection)

references.tool: <the tool that lists the uses of a symbol>
